'''Chak''' was a substance that came from the [[Spirit Tree (Endor)|Great Tree]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. It was named by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] that lived on the [[Moon/Legends|world]].

==Description==
[[File:Chak_Heart.jpg|thumb|left|A [[Chak heart]], made from a bit of bark from the [[Spirit Tree (Endor)|Great Tree]]]]
Chak was a type of bark that came from the [[Spirit Tree (Endor)|Great Tree]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>

It was an ingredient in [[Chak juice]], a beverage created by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] that was popularly sold during the [[Festival of Love]] celebrations. Ewok [[Chak heart]]s were also made from this piece of bark.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', Chak was mentioned in the description of Chak juice, a [[:w:c:swg:Drink|beverage]] introduced to the [[Star Wars video games|game]] during the Ewok [[:w:c:swg:Ewok Festival of Love|Festival of Love]] of [[2008]]. The description explained that the substance was named by the [[:w:c:swg:Ewok|Ewoks]], and that it came from the Great Tree of Endor. Additionally, Chak [[Heart/Legends|hearts]] were a type of token given to players who participated in the Festival of Love. The description mentioned that Chak hearts were made from bits of bark from the Great Tree.
